drinking_water: Distributed drinking water stations set up along queue complexes and holding sheds
annadanam: Nithya Annadanam (free daily meals) provided to all devotees. Lunch served daily from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM; breakfast and dinner served during festivals. Sponsoring available through Temple officials.
parking: Peripheral dirt parking zones cleared along incoming highways during peak events; parking slots fill up closer to temple arch on weekends.
other_facilities: Barricaded holding sheds (pandalas) with continuous overhead industrial fans and temporary shade canopies
Medical first-aid kiosks in queue complexes
Overhead multi-nozzle shower systems supplying river water on dry bank steps
Public Address Loudspeaker Array broadcasting safety instructions, missing persons alerts, and wait time updates
CCTV surveillance monitoring Koneru pond steps and approach alleyways
Community Satralu and Traditional Guest Houses for ritual purity (Madi)
Traditional Dining Network offering custom Sattvic meals and packed return journey meals
